properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: web3signer's eth1 AWS KMS remote-signing integration. Production side: Eth1Runner wires CachedAwsKmsClientFactory/AwsKmsSignerFactory into SecpAwsBulkLoader which bulk-loads KMS keys and signs digests remotely (AwsKmsClient pins SigningAlgorithmSpec.ECDSA_SHA_256 over ECC_SECP256K1 keys); CLI side: PicoCliAwsKmsParameters/Eth1SubCommand expose the aws-kms-* options.
